scope: Source audit and in-memory execution of exact effective-row loop with synthetic rows; no bridge invocation or parent writes.

findings.problem: Effective compatible-success row retains original system-LP actual_argv and log copied from failed row.
findings.required_change: Construct a compatible-success row with actual compatible argv/log/interpreter and source/receipt bindings. Preserve original row only as explicit original_failed_attempt (or rename old fields original_*).

findings.problem: Bridge claims registered compatible completion but never loads/validates registration content against wrapper/source/runtime completion. Recording registration SHA alone does not enforce the binding.
findings.required_change: Before copy/PASS, verify registered source bytes, completion wrapper/source hashes, interpreter and NumPy/SciPy versions, registered backend selection, compatible result status/case count and intended output path. Keep original system failure and no-overwrite guard.

nonissues: Original FAIL and ImportError gate are explicit.
Canonical target must not exist, and copied result bytes are checked.
Only preselected compatible LP stage is substituted; other three return codes must be zero.
